# project1 entrypoint

Shared `_ai` rules are authoritative; this file only says what to read.

- Always: [project.md](../docs/ai/project.md) sections **At a glance**, **Guardrails** and **Commands**. Other sections (Runtime, Conventions, Review focus, Asset index) when the task needs them.
- [context.md](../docs/ai/context.md) only when current/open work matters; [memory.md](../docs/ai/memory.md) only for a related past decision or bug.
- Pipeline work: the asset's runbook and design record linked in the Asset index.
